post.description: Validates e-mail and password and returns a JWT access token. Inactive or deleted users cannot sign in. Limited to 5 attempts per minute per client IP.

get.description: Returns id, name, e-mail and role of the signed-in user.
Returns a page of customers ordered by name. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

post.description: Creates a customer with CPF or CNPJ, phone and optional e-mail and address (all or nothing). Roles: Admin, Attendant.

get.description: Returns one customer by id. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

put.description: Updates name, contact and address. The document cannot change. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

delete.description: Soft deletes a customer without open service orders or registered vehicles. Role: Admin.

post.description: Finds a customer by CPF or CNPJ sent in the body (never in the URL). Roles: Admin, Attendant.

get.description: Returns a page of services ordered by name. Only active services are listed unless includeInactive is true. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

post.description: Creates an active catalog service with name, optional description, base price greater than zero and estimated time in minutes greater than zero. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns one service by id, active or inactive (see isActive). Roles: Admin, Attendant.

put.description: Updates name, description, base price and estimated time of an active service. Inactive services must be reactivated first. Items already added to service orders keep their copied price. Role: Admin.

post.description: Hides the service from the default listing, blocks changes and blocks new service order items. Items already added to service orders are kept. Role: Admin.
Returns an inactive service to the default listing and allows changes and new service order items again. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns a page of users ordered by name. Role: Admin.

post.description: Creates a user with any role (Admin, Attendant or Mechanic), unique e-mail and strong password. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns one user by id. Role: Admin.

put.description: Changes name and role. An Admin cannot demote themselves, and the last active Admin cannot be demoted. Role: Admin.

delete.description: Deactivates and soft deletes a user. An Admin cannot delete themselves or the last active Admin. Role: Admin.

post.description: Blocks the user from signing in. An Admin cannot deactivate themselves or the last active Admin. Role: Admin.
Allows an inactive user to sign in again. Role: Admin.
Finds a user by e-mail sent in the body (never in the URL). Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns a page of vehicles ordered by brand, optionally filtered by exact license plate. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Creates a vehicle with license plate, brand, model and year for an existing customer. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

get.description: Returns one vehicle by id, with its owner and service order history. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Updates brand, model and year. The license plate and the owning customer cannot change. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

delete.description: Soft deletes a vehicle without open service orders. Role: Admin.
